core_message: Stop treating the repaired 24-row frontier as the training target. Freeze it as a canary/regression suite and shift the training loop to root-based seq2seq software-maintenance prediction.

forbidden_uses: promotion headline for broad software-maintenance capability

immediate_developer_tasks: Add root_id, episode_id, state_id, and split_component to every training row.
Enforce root-level split isolation in every manifest compiler.
Build the typed event normalizer for long-context traces.
Build the causal state extractor for meaningful decision boundaries.
Add target projectors for verifier outcome, evidence role, next action, repair intent, and patch sketch.
Add leak audits for visible target paths, post-fix evidence, same-root split overlap, and option-label shortcuts.
Keep the current bounded decoder, but move the internal training interface toward semantic candidate scoring.

compiler_role: extract failed vs successful repair transitions
build hard negatives near the true maintainer decision surface
long_context_positioning.statement: 5M+ token side-project traces are a data refinery, not the main model input contract.

next_best_step: Hook the new canonical root/event/state contracts into the existing bootstrap package lineage, then compile the first long-context-derived root manifests under strict root isolation.

stages.name: Freeze Canary
stages.objective: Keep the repaired v2.7 24-row frontier fixed as a regression/canary suite.

stages.name: Root Format
stages.objective: Adopt canonical root, episode, state, and row schemas with root-level split isolation.

stages.name: Trace Compiler
stages.objective: Turn long-context traces into typed events and extract causal states only at meaningful boundaries.

stages.name: Multi-Target Rows
stages.objective: Project many seq2seq supervision targets from each causal state.

stages.name: Semantic Candidate Scoring
stages.objective: Score real candidate actions/evidence/tests instead of internal A/B/C labels.

stages.name: Structured Decoder
stages.objective: Train grammar-constrained structured action outputs before freeform patch text.

stages.name: Patch Sketches
stages.objective: Train constrained edit-intent and verifier-delta outputs before unified diffs.

stages.name: Verified Repair
stages.objective: Train executable repair outputs with verifier-grade outcomes and hard negatives.
